Aim near100% line/branch coverage for critical logic. CRAP=C²*(1-coverageFraction)^3+C. With full coverage CRAP still equals complexity, so improve design where needed, without fragmenting functions just to game the number. These are whole-component end targets, not only changed-file targets.

Critical user restriction: NO launching or operating applications, browser/phone/emulator UI journeys, real screenshots/recordings, OS lock activation, ADB phone interactions, or manual testing. Apply one temporary mutation at a time/in isolated temporary copies without branch/worktree creation, run real automated tests, restore changes. Necessary local dependencies and dedicated testing/coverage/complexity/mutation tooling and configuration changes are authorized. Keep them proportionate and reproducible.
